findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_focus_areas" stacks urgency/override words (never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: skill_check, share_family_context · Private data: get_tutor_updates, save_family_context · Public sink: skill_check, share_family_context, list_children, save_family_context.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: skill_check, share_family_context · Private data: get_tutor_updates, save_family_context · Public sink: skill_check, share_family_context, list_children, save_family_context

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
